header: One bar per item, on one shared scale
lead: Each bar’s width is the number typed on its row, as a percentage of the plot. Scale the values yourself and name the scale in the caption.
caption: Enquiries answered within one working day, by channel, 2026, on a scale of 0 to 100 %
note: Example figures for a city’s citizen service. Below 640px each bar moves to its own line, because three columns on a phone leave a bar too narrow to read.
